examples.english: And he responded, 'Let us work diligently little by little (and) we will be saved.'

examples.english: It came to pass then, when that light-power had come down over Jesus, that it gradually surrounded him entirely.

examples.coptic: ⲁⲩⲱ ⲡϫⲟⲉⲓⲥ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ ⲛⲁϥⲱⲧⲉ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲛⲉⲓϩⲉⲑⲛⲟⲥ ϩⲓϩⲏ ⲙⲙⲟⲕ **ϣⲏⲙ **ϣⲏⲙ**** ⲛⲅⲛⲁϣϥⲟⲧⲟⲩ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲧⲉⲩⲛⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲛⲛⲉⲡⲕⲁϩ ⲣϫⲁⲓⲉ ⲉⲣⲟⲕ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉⲑⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲛⲁⲅⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲁϣⲁⲓ ⲉϩⲣⲁⲓ ⲉⲣⲟⲕ
examples.english: And the Lord thy God shall consume these nations before thee by little and little: thou shalt not be able to consume them speedily, lest the land become desert, and the wild beasts of the field be multiplied against thee.
